refractive_index_curve.source: WCSim src/WCSimConstructMaterials.cc water RINDEX1 (60 points at Geant4 photon energies 1.56962-6.19998 eV, lambda = hc/E)
refractive_index_curve.description: Phase index n(lambda). In wavelength mode photons propagate at the group velocity c / n_g(lambda), n_g = n - lambda dn/dlambda (as Geant4 derives GROUPVEL from RINDEX); the scalar refractive_index above is kept for everything else.

symmetric.description: Rayleigh + symmetric Mie: alpha_sym = P4/lambda^4 * (1 + P5/lambda^2)

asymmetric.description: Forward Mie: alpha_asym = P6 * (1 + P7/lambda^4 * (lambda - P8)^2)

absorption.source: SK calibration paper (arXiv:1307.0162), Eqs. 14-15, Table 3 + Pope & Fry (1997)
absorption.description: alpha_abs = P0*P1/lambda^4 + C(lambda); C = power law (<464nm) or Pope&Fry (>=464nm). Pope&Fry knots corrected 2026-07 to the authoritative omlc.org/spectra/water/data/pope97.txt values (converted 1/cm -> 1/m); the previous table was mistranscribed (blue knots ~2x low, red knots 10-20% high, discontinuity at the 464nm splice). First knot is Pope&Fry's 465nm sample (their grid has no 464nm point); the power-law/Pope&Fry blend stays centered at 464nm.
